create_CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE: create a CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE quantization scheme for W4A4 NVFP4 MoE layers on Blackwell GPUs
create_moe_runner: create an MoE runner for a quantized MoE layer using MoeRunnerConfig with Triton backend
